free_tier.stated: 10GB basic space on the Free Plan at $0/Year, with 10GB/day high-speed traffic; the paid Personal Plan is 1 TB Basic Storage

egress.terms: Beyond the high-speed traffic allowance, large-file downloads are limited to 100KB/s; viewing small files such as photos has no speed limit; buying Premium lifts the limit. The plan page and the FAQ give different allowances (see limits).

interface_detail: webdav at https://webdav.febbox.com, per-account credentials with a chosen authorization directory and a read-only option
tooling: WebDAV access is enabled in the account settings (server address https://webdav.febbox.com), usable from rclone and WinSCP; the site also lists an Open Platform.

limits.value: 10GB basic space on the Free Plan; 1 TB Basic Storage on the Personal Plan
10GB/day high-speed traffic on the Free Plan; 100GB/day on the Personal Plan (the FAQ says 100GB per month for free users)

reliability_note: Per the FAQ, a downgrade to the free plan leaves existing files readable, allows no new uploads while over the free storage limit, and deletes files if usage stays over the limit for 3 months.
confidence_note: Documented from vendor pages re-read on 2026-11-04: https://www.febbox.com/plan (free 10GB basic space; Personal Plan 1 TB), https://www.febbox.com/faq (throttle, 3-month deletion over the limit, purchasable capacity) and https://www.febbox.com/article/detail/id/34 (WebDAV server).
